messages:
riley (brightleaf): Hey—we just rolled a prod deploy and traffic is getting 403s and throttled. Console shows the API key we generated earlier but the app says 'rate limit exceeded'. Can you check?

sophie (support): Sorry for the trouble, riley. Can you paste the first 8 chars of the API key and the org id? Also which project you expected it to belong to (prod vs staging)?

riley (brightleaf): Key starts rk_live_9a3b4c2d..., org org_BLF9. We intended this for the `brightleaf-prod` project. In the console I clicked New API Key → Prod role. It showed success.

sophie (support): Thanks. On it. Paging provisioning-bot to surface recent key events. @provisioning-bot any logs for org_BLF9 around 2023-09-24T14:00Z?

provisioning-bot: log: API Key created id=rk_live_9a3b4c2d owner=riley org=org_BLF9 project=brightleaf-staging role=api:invoke timestamp=2023-09-24T14:02:31Z

sophie (support): Huh — bot shows the key was bound to brightleaf-staging. @raj can you check if the console default project selector picked staging by accident?

raj (provisioning): Looking. I pulled the provisioning audit. It shows the create request sent project_id=proj_779 (brightleaf-staging). The console UI should have set proj_881 (brightleaf-prod) but there's a stale client-side cache entry for the org that had staging selected. Seems like a client race where the last-used project was persisted.

riley (brightleaf): Oh no. That explains the throttles — staging quotas are lower and a cron test blew past it. Is there a way to rebind that key without rotating? We have the key baked into k8s secrets now.

raj (provisioning): Short answer: we can reassign in the admin plane but best practice is rotate keys so you can confirm a clean binding and avoid shadow tokens. Options: (1) create a new prod-scoped key, update secrets and roll; (2) admin reassign existing key to prod (we can do that but recommend rotation). Which do you prefer?

sophie (support): For immediate relief, I'll generate a new prod key and set it to expire in 7d so you can roll safely. Then we'll revoke the staging key.

ops-oncall: FYI, this pattern has been popping up. I'll open a follow-up to make the console explicitly surface the target project during key creation (no silent defaults).

riley (brightleaf): Option 1 sounds good. Please generate prod key. Also can you confirm scopes? We need text-generation and embeddings.

sophie (support): Generated new key id=rk_live_f7e1a0b2 (masked rk_live_f7e1a0b2****). Bound to project brightleaf-prod (proj_881). Scopes: ["api:invoke","embeddings:read"]. TTL: 7 days.

riley (brightleaf): Got it, testing now.

riley (brightleaf): quick update — swapped the secret, pods picked it up, traffic is green and no throttles. Thanks! :tada:

sophie (support): Great. We'll revoke the staging key now and keep a record of the incident. Revoke command run: 
```
POST /admin/keys/revoke
{
  "key_id": "rk_live_9a3b4c2d",
  "reason": "misbound to staging, replaced by rotation"
}
```

provisioning-bot: log: API Key revoked id=rk_live_9a3b4c2d by=sophie reason=misbound_to_staging timestamp=2023-09-24T14:29:48Z

sophie (support): Next steps for us: (1) open a console bug to surface project choice and clear stale client cache; (2) add server-side validation to warn if selected project doesn't match org default; (3) ops opened issue for guidance to customers about key rotation.

ops-oncall: Created issue INF-3124 "console: make project explicit during API key creation" and assigned to eng-console.

riley (brightleaf): Appreciate the quick help. Any way to audit: which services used the staging key so we can check logs?

raj (provisioning): We can provide a short usage report for the revoked key (last 24h). I'll DM you the CSV with request_id, model, token_count.

riley (brightleaf): Perfect, thanks everyone.

sophie (support): Closing this thread — please reopen if anything else shows up. :thumbsup:
